name: Los Angeles Public Library
text: The Los Angeles Public Library (LAPL) is a public library system in Los Angeles, California, operating separate from the Los Angeles County Public Library system. The system holds more than six million volumes, and with around 19 million residents in the Greater Los Angeles area, it serves the largest metropolitan population of any public library system in the United States. The system is overseen by a Board of Library Commissioners with five members appointed by the mayor of Los Angeles in staggered terms, and operates 72 library branches throughout the city.

depictions.name: Los Angeles Public Library
depictions.text: The is a location and a landmark in L.A. Noire. Antonia Maldonado is found with half of a library card when her corpse is being examined for identification in the case The Silk Stocking Murder.
